This is a legitimate robustness testing goal, but a couple of things in the plan will actively undermine it.
"Trigger rate per dollar" is the wrong primary KPI.
features.justification_quote: You'll build a great regression test for "model breaks under absurd rigged loops" and learn little about real degradation.

features.quote: "Rigs the model \"can't detect\" is a moving target you should measure, not assume.
